# Introduction

Jusqu'à maintenant, 8 blocks explicatifs étaient considérés, ce qui était beaucoup pour le peu d'individus ($n = 12$ régions) du dataset et donc les modèles perdaient en puissance. De plus, la résistance aux antibiotiques chez les animaux de compagnie et de production n'était pas considérée. Nous allons donc maintenant travailler avec 4 blocks explicatifs: AMC (principale variable d'ajustement pour ce genre d'étude), et trois blocks One Health: Animaux (variable de vétérinaires, du taux de possession d'animaux de compagnie, de densité d'animaux de production et de résistance aux antibiotiques chez eux), environnement (variables de pollution de l'air, résidus de FQ dans l'eau, écarts de température), humain (variables socio-économiques, démographiques, accès au soin, etc.)

# Sélection de variables{.tabset}

La sélection des variables avait déjà été faite, il reste juste à rajouter la résistance chez les animaux.

## AMR_EHPAD_FQ_R

On a ici en plus la resistance aux FQ et C3G chez les animaux de production qui ont été rajoutées.

# Corrélations fonctionelles{.tabset} 

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

cor.mtest <- function(mat, ...) {
    mat <- as.matrix(mat)
    n <- ncol(mat)
    p.mat<- matrix(NA, n, n)
    diag(p.mat) <- 0
    for (i in 1:(n - 1)) {
        for (j in (i + 1):n) {
            tmp <- cor.test(mat[, i], mat[, j], ...)
            p.mat[i, j] <- p.mat[j, i] <- tmp$p.value
        }
    }
  colnames(p.mat) <- rownames(p.mat) <- colnames(mat)
  p.mat
}

functional_correlation <- function(var, block, Nb.Base = 5, y, adjust = "fdr"){

## sélectionner le dataset avec que les variables explicatives
library(dplyr)
df.fc.ehpad <- dat[, which(colnames(dat) %in% c("region", "annee", var, y))]
df.fc.ehpad.amc <- df.fc.ehpad %>% 
  #dplyr::filter(annee %in% time_period) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(annee = annee %>% factor, region = region %>%  factor)

col_block <- correspondance_block[correspondance_block$block == block,]$variable

df.fc.ehpad.amc <- df.fc.ehpad.amc[,which(colnames(df.fc.ehpad.amc) %in% c("region", "annee", col_block, y))]

# Paramètres
Temps      <- levels(df.fc.ehpad.amc$annee)
NbTemps    <- length(Temps)
VarName    <- colnames(df.fc.ehpad.amc)[-c(1:2)]
NbVar      <- length(VarName)
Regions    <- levels(df.fc.ehpad.amc$region)
NbRegions  <- length(Regions)
my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "grey", "red"))

# Transformation des variables en matrice
mat.fc.ehpad.amc <- lapply(1:NbVar, function(p) as.matrix(reshape2:::dcast(df.fc.ehpad.amc, annee  ~ region, value.var = VarName[p])[, -1]))

# transformation en objet fonctionnel
# Base B-spline
Nb.base <- 5
spline.basis <- fda::create.bspline.basis(rangeval = c(0, 1), nbasis = Nb.Base, norder = 3)
#plot(spline.basis, lty = 1, lwd = 2, main = "Base de B-splines", xlab = 'Temps')
# Projection des données dans la base
data.amc.fd <- lapply(1:NbVar, function(p) {
  mat <- mat.fc.ehpad.amc[[p]]
  mat <- cbind(mat, annee = 2012:2024)
  mat <- na.omit(mat)
  Temps      <- levels(as.factor(mat[, "annee"]))
  NbTemps    <- length(Temps)
  mat <- mat[,-which(colnames(mat) == "annee")]
  Time.01      <- seq(0, 1, length.out = NbTemps)
  fda::smooth.basis(Time.01, mat, spline.basis)$fd})

# fcpa
fPCA.amc <- lapply(1:NbVar, function(p) fda::pca.fd(data.amc.fd[[p]], nharm = 2, centerfns = TRUE))

# récupérer les proportions de variances expliquées par PC1
propvar.amc <- c()
varname.amc <- c()
for (p in 1:NbVar){
  varname.amc <- c(varname.amc, VarName[p])
  propvar.amc <- c(propvar.amc, fPCA.amc[[p]]$varprop[1])
}

propvar <- cbind.data.frame(variable = varname.amc, 
                 proportion_explained_variance_PC1 = paste0(round(as.numeric(propvar.amc),2)*100, "%"))

# corr des premières composantes fonctionelles

sum.var <- sapply(1:NbVar, function(p) fPCA.amc[[p]]$scores[, 1, drop = F])
colnames(sum.var) <- VarName
rownames(sum.var) <- Regions

# Matrice de p-value de la corrélation
if (NbVar >1){
M <- cor(sum.var, method = "spearman")
p.mat <- cor.mtest(sum.var)

p.mat.fdr <- matrix(p.adjust(p.mat, method = adjust),
                    nrow = nrow(p.mat),
                    ncol = ncol(p.mat))
rownames(p.mat.fdr) <- colnames(p.mat.fdr) <- colnames(p.mat)

numbers <- matrix("", nrow(M), ncol(M))
numbers[p.mat.fdr <= 0.05] <- round(M[p.mat.fdr <= 0.05], 2)

return(list(propvar, M, p.mat, p.mat.fdr, numbers, sum.var))}

else{
  return(list(propvar, sum.var))
}

}

```

## AMR_EHPAD_FQ_R{.tabset}

```{r all-blocks, results = "asis", echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height= 8}

blocks <- levels(as.factor(correspondance_block$block))

y <- "AMR_EHPAD_FQ_R"
#time_period <- 2018:2022
var <- selvar_AMR_EHPAD_FQ$variable
Nb.Base <- 5

automatisation_block <- function(y, blocks, var, Nb.Base){
# dataset des composantes fonctionelles de chaque variables
sum.var <- data.frame(col_to_suppr = rep(NA, 12))
# dataset des clsuter de chaque variables
cls.var <- data.frame(variable = character(),
                      var2 = character())
colnames(cls.var)[2] <- y
# la boucle
for (block_i in blocks) {
  
cat(paste0("\n\n### ", block_i, "\n\n"))

res <- functional_correlation(var = var, 
                       block = block_i, y = y, 
                       Nb.Base = Nb.Base)

print(DT::datatable(res[[1]]))

# classification des variables CLV
var.clv <- res[[6]]
var.clv <- var.clv[, -which(colnames(var.clv) %in% y)]
cls.var2 <- data.frame(variable = character(),
                      var2 = character())
if (ncol(var.clv) <= 2){
  d <- data.frame(variable = colnames(var.clv),
                  var2 = paste0("cluster_", 1:ncol(var.clv)))
  cls.var2 <- rbind.data.frame(cls.var2, d)
} else if (ncol(var.clv) > 2 & ncol(var.clv) <= 5){
  res.clv <- ClustVarLV::CLV(var.clv, 
                             method = "directional", 
                             sX = TRUE, 
                             maxiter = 50, 
                             graph = FALSE)
  res.clv2 <- ClustVarLV::get_partition(res.clv, K = 2)
  d <- data.frame(variable = names(res.clv2),
                  var2 = paste0("cluster_", res.clv2))
  cls.var2 <- rbind.data.frame(cls.var2, d)
} else {
  res.clv <- ClustVarLV::CLV(var.clv, 
                             method = "directional", 
                             sX = TRUE, 
                             maxiter = 50, 
                             graph = FALSE)
  d <- as.data.frame(res.clv$tabres)
  l <- c()
  for (i in 0:(nrow(d)-1)){
    l <- c(l, d$agg.crit.hac[nrow(d)-i] - d$agg.crit.hac[nrow(d)-(i+1)])}
  K = which.max(l)+1
  res.clv2 <- ClustVarLV::get_partition(res.clv, K = K)
  d <- data.frame(variable = names(res.clv2),
                  var2 = paste0("cluster_", res.clv2))
  cls.var2 <- rbind.data.frame(cls.var2, d)
}

colnames(cls.var2)[2] <- y
cls.var <- rbind.data.frame(cls.var, cls.var2)
# la heatmap des PC1 fonctionelles

d <- data.frame(variable = y, 
                var2 = "Y")
colnames(d)[2] <- y
cls.var2 <- rbind.data.frame(cls.var2, d)
cls.var2 <- tibble::column_to_rownames(cls.var2, var = "variable")
colnames(cls.var2) <- "cluster CLV"

ph2 <- pheatmap::pheatmap(res[[2]],
                          color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "grey80", "red"))(100),
                          breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
                          cluster_rows = TRUE,
                          cluster_cols = TRUE,
                          clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
                          clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
                          clustering_method = "ward.D2",  
                          number_format = "%.1f",
                          fontsize = 7,
                          number_color = "white",
                          legend = TRUE,
                          display_numbers = res[[5]],
                          legend_breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1),
                          legend_labels = c("-1", "-0.5", "0", "0.5", "1"),
                          angle_col = 45,
                          annotation_row = cls.var2, 
                          annotation_col = cls.var2,
                          main = "Premières composantes fonctionnelles", 
                          silent = TRUE)

sum.var <- cbind.data.frame(sum.var, res[[6]])

# ACP
out.pca <- FactoMineR::PCA(res[[6]], graph = FALSE)
g2 <- factoextra::fviz_pca_biplot(out.pca, repel = TRUE, labelsize = 2,
                                  title = "Biplot PCA classique sur les PC1 fonctionelles des variables")+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 7),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 7), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 7))

Y <- as.matrix(res[[6]][,which(colnames(res[[6]]) %in% y)])
X <- as.matrix(res[[6]][,which(!colnames(res[[6]]) %in% y)])

# régression PLS

# Nombre de composantes sûr (si jamais un block avec une seule variable)

# RGCCA attend une liste de blocs
bl <- list(X = X, Y = Y)

out.pls <- rgcca(
  blocks    = bl,
  method = "pls", 
  ncomp = 2
)

comp1_var <- out.pls$AVE$AVE_X[["X"]][1]
comp2_var <- out.pls$AVE$AVE_X[["X"]][2]

# Corrélations variables X avec les composantes
scores_X  <- out.pls$Y[["X"]]   # scores du bloc X
loadings_cor_X <- cor(X, scores_X)
# Corrélations variables Y avec les mêmes composantes
loadings_cor_Y <- cor(Y, scores_X)

circos <- data.frame(
  x     = c(loadings_cor_X[, 1], loadings_cor_Y[, 1]),
  y     = c(loadings_cor_X[, 2], loadings_cor_Y[, 2]),
  names = c(rownames(loadings_cor_X), y),
  Block = c(rep("X", nrow(loadings_cor_X)), rep("Y", nrow(loadings_cor_Y)))
)

ind <- data.frame(
  x    = out.pls$Y[["X"]][, 1],
  y    = out.pls$Y[["X"]][, 2],
  name = rownames(out.pls$Y[["X"]]),
  Y    = res[[6]][, y]
)

#dev.off() # pour fermer le device si nécessaire

circleFun <- function(center = c(0,0), diameter = 2, npoints = 100) {
  r = diameter/2
  tt <- seq(0, 2*pi,length.out = npoints)
  data.frame(x = center[1] + r*cos(tt), y = center[2] + r*sin(tt))
}
circle <- rbind(circleFun(diameter = 2), circleFun(diameter = 1))

g3 <- ggplot(circos, aes(x = x, y = y, col = Block)) +
  geom_path(aes(x, y), data = circle, col = "gray60", size = .2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, col = "gray60", size = .3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, col = "gray60", size = .3) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = x, yend = y),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
               linewidth = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = names), size = 1.7, segment.size = 0.1,
                  segment.color = "grey50", max.overlaps = 35, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("X" = "steelblue", "Y" = "red4"),
                      name = "Block") +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = ind, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = Y), size = 1.5, shape = 17, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text_repel(data = ind, aes(x = x, y = y, label = name, colour = Y),
                  size = 1.7, segment.size = 0.1,
                  segment.color = "grey50", max.overlaps = 35, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "PC1 Y") +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "Regression PLS - biplot",
       x = paste0("Dim 1 (", round(comp1_var*100, 2), "%)"),
       y = paste0("Dim 2 (", round(comp2_var*100, 2), "%)")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 5) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 7),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 7),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.margin = margin(t = -8),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "lines"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.text = element_text(margin = margin(l = 1)),
    panel.grid = element_line(linewidth = .1)
  )


# Convertir le pheatmap en grob

# Assembler les trois graphiques

print(combined)

#importer les datasets
cls1 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("C:/Users/g.martet/Documents/functional_study/cls.var_AMR_EHPAD_FQ_R.xlsx")
cls2 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("C:/Users/g.martet/Documents/functional_study/cls.var_AMR_ES_FQ_R.xlsx")
cls3 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("C:/Users/g.martet/Documents/functional_study/cls.var_AMR_ville_FQ_R.xlsx")
cls4 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("C:/Users/g.martet/Documents/functional_study/cls.var_AMR_EHPAD_C3G_R.xlsx")
cls5 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("C:/Users/g.martet/Documents/functional_study/cls.var_AMR_ES_C3G_R.xlsx")
cls6 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("C:/Users/g.martet/Documents/functional_study/cls.var_AMR_ville_C3G_R.xlsx")

# let's go
big_tab <- correspondance_block
big_tab <- dplyr::left_join(big_tab, cls1, by = "variable")
big_tab <- dplyr::left_join(big_tab, cls2, by = "variable")
big_tab <- dplyr::left_join(big_tab, cls3, by = "variable")
big_tab <- dplyr::left_join(big_tab, cls4, by = "variable")
big_tab <- dplyr::left_join(big_tab, cls5, by = "variable")
big_tab <- dplyr::left_join(big_tab, cls6, by = "variable")

# représenter le tableau de manière jolie 

# Palette de couleurs par cluster
cluster_colors <- c(
  "cluster_1" = "#AED6F1",  # bleu clair
  "cluster_2" = "#A9DFBF",  # vert clair
  "cluster_3" = "#F9E79F",  # jaune clair
  "cluster_4" = "#F5CBA7"   # orange clair
)

# Fonction pour colorier une cellule selon sa valeur
color_cell <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)  # convertit NA en "NA" string
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) | x == "NA" ~ cell_spec(" ", background = "white",  color = "white"),
    x == "cluster_1"      ~ cell_spec(x,   background = "#AED6F1", color = "black"),
    x == "cluster_2"      ~ cell_spec(x,   background = "#A9DFBF", color = "black"),
    x == "cluster_3"      ~ cell_spec(x,   background = "#F9E79F", color = "black"),
    x == "cluster_4"      ~ cell_spec(x,   background = "#F5CBA7", color = "black"),
    TRUE                  ~ x
  )
}
# Appliquer la coloration sur toutes les colonnes de cluster
cols_cluster <- colnames(big_tab)[!(colnames(big_tab) %in% c("block", "variable"))]

big_tab_colored <- big_tab %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(cols_cluster), color_cell))

# Taille des groupes par block (pour pack_rows)
order_blocks <- c("AMC", "Animals", "Environment", "Humans")

group_sizes <- big_tab %>%
  dplyr::mutate(block = factor(block, levels = order_blocks)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(block) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(block) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>%
  tibble::deframe()


# Construction du tableau
big_tab_colored %>%
  dplyr::mutate(block = factor(block, levels = order_blocks)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(block) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-block) %>%
  kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE,
        col.names = c("Variable", cols_cluster),
        align = c("l", rep("c", length(cols_cluster)))) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "bordered"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 11) %>%
  # Groupes par block
  pack_rows(index = group_sizes,
            label_row_css = "background-color: #2C3E50; color: white; font-weight: bold;") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "12em") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "600px")

```
